newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian model in coma after plastic surgery.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian model in coma after plastic surgery.

text.p: A top Brazilian model, Claudia Liz, has fallen into a deep coma after developing an allergic reaction to an anaesthetic used in a liposuction operation on her stomach, a hospital spokesman said on Thursday.
The 27-year-old blonde suffered a cardiac arrest which briefly interrupted the oxygen supply to her brain and left her in a coma, the spokesman said.

Liz was being kept on a life support system in the Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein in Sao Paulo, to which she was transferred late Tuesday from a private clinic where she was having the plastic surgery.
The model has a five-year-old son and married for the second time a few months ago. She is currently featured in a television soap opera.
